info.album: If Not For You (Deluxe Edition / Remastered 2022)

podcast.body: Olivia Newton-John's first hit single, a cover of Bob Dylan's song. The speaker personally found her version to be superior to Dylan's. "Look no further than her cover of Bob Dylan's If Not For You in 1971, which was her first hit single."

Originally written by Bob Dylan in 1970 and popularized by George Harrison, Olivia Newton-John's manager suggested she cover it. John Farrar produced her version, mirroring Harrison's arrangement with a slide guitar, leading to Newton-John's first actual hit. This song reached the top 10 in the UK and peaked at number 25 on the Hot 100 in America. It also climbed to number one on Billboard's Adult Contemporary Chart (then known as Easy Listening). "And Olivia had an actual hit with it."
